 */import{normalizeText}from'./textProcessing';import{detectSubjunctiveInClause}from'./clauseBoundaryAnalyzer';/**

if(hasFiniteVerb)confidence+=0.3;if(hasAvantQueSubjectVerb)confidence+=0.3;const isComplementClause=confidence>=0.4;console.log('🔍 Complement clause result:',{isComplementClause,confidence:Math.min(confidence,1.0)});return{isComplementClause,confidence:Math.min(confidence,1.0),evidence:{hasSubjectPronoun,hasDemonstrativePronoun,// ADDED
